subtopic: Form CRS and Form ADV Fee Disclosures
source_evidence: Form CRS (also called the client relationship summary or Form ADV Part 3) will give you a summary of the fees an adviser charges and the services it offers.
answer: Form CRS, also called Form ADV Part 3, provides a summary of an adviser’s fees and services. For additional generalized information, you can read the adviser’s responses to Items 4 and 5 in Form ADV Part 2A, also called the adviser’s brochure. These disclosures can help you understand what fees are charged and what services the adviser offers.
